kpis.signal: Plus gros segment Halliburton (~58% CA), expose au pressure pumping et completion US shale, marge operationnelle 20% en 2024
kpis.description_fr: CA segment Completion & Production : cementing, stimulation, intervention, pressure control, artificial lift, completion tools. Coeur du business HAL, tres expose aux activites de fracturation US.
kpis.description_en: Completion & Production segment revenue: cementing, stimulation, intervention, pressure control, artificial lift, completion tools. Core HAL business, highly exposed to US fracking activity.

kpis.signal: Segment international leader, marge operationnelle 16% en 2024, +4% portee par drilling Western Hemisphere et fluids hors Mexique
kpis.description_fr: CA segment Drilling & Evaluation : drilling, fluids, evaluation, wellbore placement. Plus international que C&P, expose aux gros projets offshore et Moyen-Orient.
kpis.description_en: Drilling & Evaluation segment revenue: drilling, fluids, evaluation, wellbore placement. More international than C&P, exposed to large offshore and Middle East projects.

kpis.signal: Marche US shale en repli en 2024 (-8%) suite baisse rig count et pricing pressure pumping, ~42% du CA group
kpis.description_fr: CA Amerique du Nord : US land, Canada, Golfe du Mexique. Marche le plus cyclique pour HAL, sensible au rig count US et aux prix gaz/petrole.
kpis.description_en: North America revenue: US land, Canada, Gulf of Mexico. Most cyclical HAL market, sensitive to US rig count and oil/gas prices.

kpis.signal: Region en plus forte croissance HAL (+7.5%), portee par Saudi Aramco, Emirats, gros contrats integres
kpis.description_fr: CA Moyen-Orient/Asie : Saudi Aramco, ADNOC, Asie Pacifique. Region en plus forte croissance, projets longue duree avec marges resilientes.
kpis.description_en: Middle East/Asia revenue: Saudi Aramco, ADNOC, Asia Pacific. Fastest growing region, long-cycle projects with resilient margins.

kpis.signal: Resultat op 2024 en repli leger malgre CA flat, impact charges SAP S4 (124M$) et impairments (116M$), marge op 16.7%
kpis.description_fr: Resultat operationnel consolide : reflete la rentabilite combinee C&P + D&E moins frais corporate et impairments. Marge op 2024 = 16.7%.
kpis.description_en: Consolidated operating income: reflects combined C&P + D&E profitability minus corporate and impairments. 2024 op margin = 16.7%.
